storyCards.fact:
The Animals's "Don't Let Me Be Misunderstood" reached #15 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #15 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 10 weeks on the chart.

Don't Let Me Be Misunderstood was released in 1965.

"Don't Let Me Be Misunderstood" by The Animals.
